newsitem.title: USA: General Signal to redeem $100 mln in notes.
newsitem.headline: General Signal to redeem $100 mln in notes.

text.p: General Signal said it called for redemption its $100 million 5.75 percent convertible suborbinated notes, due 2002, and said it would buy back up to $100 million of its common stock.
The redemption date for the notes is January 2, the company said.
Prior to that time, the notes' holders may convert the notes into the company's common stock at a rate of 25.32 shares of common stock per 1,000 of notes' principal.
The stock buyback will offset any shares issued as a result of the redemption, the company added.
